summary: Verified bug-fix for slow apartment photo loading. Backend ETag/304/thumb behavior and frontend ?thumb=1 + lazy loading all working. 6/6 pytest tests pass, admin apartments UI renders thumb URLs correctly.
verified_behaviors: GET with If-None-Match="<asset_id>" returns 304 with 0-byte body — PASS
GET ?thumb=1 returns downscaled image with ETag='"<asset_id>-t"', smaller than original (2.5x for tiny synthetic gradient PNG; real JPEG photos will see much more)  — PASS
Second thumb request served from cached thumb_b64 (bytes identical, no regen) — PASS
Admin > Appartementen: 4/4 apartment card imgs use `?thumb=1` and have loading='lazy' decoding='async' — PASS
External http:// photo URLs are NOT modified with thumb=1 (frontend guard on '/api/landing/asset/') — code-verified
PhotoUpload preview also uses ?thumb=1 for landing asset URLs — code-verified
critical_code_review_comments: Note: ingress overrides Cache-Control to no-store (as flagged in the request); did not flag. The ETag/304 fast-path still triggers via If-None-Match and is the real speedup.

Minor: PIL thumbnail generation is CPU-bound and runs inside async endpoint without run_in_executor — first-hit for a very large image could briefly block the event loop. Mitigated by DB caching after first request; safe to defer.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_photo.png uploaded via /api/companies/me/branding/upload during pytest run; kept in landing_assets (asset URL scoped to test; harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_landing_asset_cache.py covers full ETag/304/thumb path. Reusable for regression.
